description: Auto-fill a batch of enterprise security, GDPR, and EU AI Act vendor questionnaire / RFP questions (e.g. OneTrust, SIG, Whistic, CAIQ, custom Excel). Returns structured answers with EUR-Lex statutory citations, technical proofs, and copy-pasteable memos. When no Polar license key is provided, returns free answers for the first 2 questions and a direct checkout link for the remainder.

ai_provider.description: Primary AI model provider (e.g. 'Mistral AI', 'OpenAI EU', 'Self-hosted').

company_name.description: Name of your organisation (optional, defaults to 'Our Organisation').

polar_license_key.description: Optional Polar license key (e.g. ec_live_... or license purchased via Polar). If omitted, returns first 2 questions answered and an instant checkout link.

primary_hosting.description: Primary cloud hosting location (e.g. 'Frankfurt, Germany', 'Dublin, Ireland').

questions.description: Array of question strings from the procurement or security questionnaire.

name: autofill_security_questionnaire

outputSchema.description: Batch questionnaire output with status, answered questions, statutory citations, and checkout link if partially locked.
